content.title: Suns+ | Watch The Suns Online, At Home, Or On The Go | NBA.com
content.text: Stream YOUR Phoenix Suns+, At Home or On the GoSuns+ is the official streaming platform of YOUR Phoenix Suns. Go behind the scenes, enjoy special features, and even chat with fellow Suns superfans—whether you’re at home or on the go. Watch the way you want—on your phone, desktop, or connected device. Available across devices for in-market fans only.Most PopularAnnualCatch the hottest Suns action 24/7, live or on-demand! Stream all locally televised games, full replays, the latest features, and exclusive original content.MonthlySubscribe for access to live games, game replays, and more.Unfortunately, you are not eligible for Suns+ because you are located outside of the distribution area.Instead, please check out NBA League Pass and get access to hundreds of live games across the league, 24/7 coverage and highlights.Frequently Asked QuestionsSuns+ is the streaming home of the Phoenix Suns. Subscribers can live stream all locally broadcast games including all regular season and preseason games throughout the 2025-26 season at plus.suns.com.Subscriptions to Suns+ are available for $14.99 per month or $109.99 per year. Suns+ is only available to Arizona residents and residents in the Albuquerque metro area. Fans can check if they live in an eligible zip code at plus.suns.com.Fans can go to plus.suns.com to select their preferred subscription package.Subscribers can access the platform outside of the viewing territory for 30 consecutive days. After 30 days, subscribers must return to the viewing area to re-authenticate their device to access the platform.Suns+ will simulcast all local, regular season Suns games and all local preseason games during the 2025-26 season along with original content on plus.suns.com. During the 2025-26 season, all local, regular season Suns games and all local preseason games will simulcast on Suns+. Any nationally exclusive broadcasts will not be available on Suns+. Visit plus.suns.com to access more information.The Annual Suns+ subscription is for a full calendar year. Use promo code "SUNSPLUS31" for $31 off your Annual subscription purchase during checkout, now for a limited time!Sharing account login information is not allowed. Each account is enabled for viewing on one device only. If more than one person is logged in, the first viewer is logged out.Yes, paid Suns+ subscriptions will automatically renew unless you cancel or opt out of auto-renewal. You will receive an email reminder 30 days before being charged.If you are experiencing technical issues, please contact streaming-support@suns.com for support.Suns game replays are available for the entire 2025-26 season for every local game, a few hours after the conclusion of the live broadcast. An NBA ID is a free account created with an email to receive access to personalized content and exclusive benefits when using the NBA mobile app and website. The NBA ID is also required for accessing Suns+. If you already have an NBA ID, you can use those credentials to sign in and subscribe to Suns+. Otherwise, you can sign up for NBA ID at www.nba.com/id.
